message: Small update steps start at 1.0.4. Original baselines (Windows/Android 1.0.0; Linux/macOS 1.0.2) retain their direct patch to 1.0.6. Other intermediate installations below 1.0.4 require a full installation; see the Workshop guide. Reopen MDPro4 and check again after each staged update.
notes:
1. Fixed card-statistics pictures and Exodia's special-win presentation when native card-rendering services are unavailable, with picture cleanup when the view closes or playback is interrupted.
2. Cancelling a file or background picker now leaves the current content unchanged without reporting an import error.
3. Fixed card details opening after the selected deck card was removed, including removal of the last card.
4. Improved macOS application-file replacement during updates to avoid stale code-signature caching when reopening the game. Newly prepared patches also support this replacement on older updaters.
5. Invalid or empty Progression exchange text now shows an input error without changing saved series or backups.
6. Fixed deleting and moving decks when no deck tile is selected. A failed move now keeps the original deck and selected row. Overlong deck names receive clear feedback before creating a file.
7. Each running game now owns its temporary database and WindBot files. Closing one instance no longer clears another instance's working files or unrelated Android caches.
8. Fixed selector callbacks and ordered-trigger popups retiring while their actions are still running, and cancelled duel messages before shutdown animation cleanup.
9. Unsupported native duel platforms and campaign decks containing unavailable native cards now show guidance before trying to start the duel.
10. Restored missing character expressions and corrected Kalin's alternate character voice source so dialogue requests the matching expressions.
11. Random and custom profile pictures now preview correctly inside profile frames. Missing deck-case icons use the existing default icon.
12. Animated card artwork now stops waiting when video preparation fails, is cancelled, or times out, allowing later card loads to continue.
13. Release introductions now handle offline, SSL and invalid-response failures safely. Incomplete installations display localized installation guidance.
14. Completed Android updates can finish startup when temporary cleanup is blocked. Retired update files remain available for cleanup on the next launch.
15. Fixed bookmark switching when the optional card-detail panel is closed.
16. Empty exports now show a message. Cancelling one mobile export no longer leaves file cleanup attached to a later export.
17. Clearing expansion packs now waits for other data reloads, closes its archive readers, and reopens remaining packs if a file is locked.
18. Leaving a duel during the deck-shuffle animation now cancels its pending work and releases its overlay camera reference.
19. Wallpaper loading now skips missing native objects safely while preserving the existing wallpaper fallback.
20. Rush cut-ins now resolve the host color buffer correctly when 2x or 4x MSAA is enabled, preserving their original effects and releasing their rendering resources after playback.
21. Local-server port checks now allow Unix ports retained by recently closed connections while still rejecting active listeners. Failed connection-worker startup no longer reports a misleading port conflict.
22. Fixed Linux file, folder and save dialogs failing in IL2CPP players. Cancelling a dialog leaves the current selection unchanged.
23. The deck browser no longer shows commands that modify the Deck Editor. Card details remain available in both views.
24. Hidden deck cards no longer start animations, and closing a deck view safely restores or removes cards whose animation is still running.
25. Ordinary Master Duel Adventure duels now use a fresh shuffle seed on each attempt instead of repeating the captured opening hand. Scripted tutorials and saved replays retain their authored or recorded order.
26. New Test Hand settings now shuffle the deck by default. Previously saved shuffle preferences remain unchanged.
27. Updated Rush cards and artwork variants with corrected IDs, current prerelease effects and translations, ten restored Over Rush artworks, and seven restored normal or alternate artworks.
28. From last Test Hand now opens an unsaved Combo Sheet. A new library entry is created only when you choose Save; leaving the editor uses the normal save or discard prompt.
29. Invalid oversized IDs in external card mappings no longer interrupt card-artwork loading. Valid IDs in the same mapping remain available.
30. Cancelling artwork loads now completes UI cleanup on the Unity thread, preventing loading-indicator errors when changing appearance items.
31. Assigned AI decks now replace existing deck arguments correctly, including when the AI executor is chosen randomly. Forced opening hands also replace existing hand arguments.
32. Card details now retain the selected card and its individual appearance if the deck or history list changes while the reader is opening.
33. Native asset folders now ignore Explorer and Finder metadata files, preventing desktop.ini and similar files from blocking wallpaper or cosmetic loading.
34. Animated profile frames no longer report missing texture-property errors when using their original native profile shader.
35. Duels now use the standard card protector when a selected optional sleeve is unavailable, preventing field initialization from receiving an empty card back.
36. Card holograms now recover after effect presentations. An earlier hide animation can no longer switch off a newly shown hologram.
37. Monsters Special Summoned from the Deck now finish loading their revealed card picture before travelling to the field, including cold artwork loads.
38. Queued card-data lookups now stop at message boundaries, preventing an end-of-stream error when an update contains no matching card or only partial card information.
39. Pointer input no longer reports missing-camera errors while the duel interface is starting or closing.
40. Card-selection shortcut icons now follow the active input method. Simply plugging in a controller no longer replaces mouse or touch hints.
41. Attribute and Type declarations now allow the full number requested by the effect. Earthshaker can declare two Attributes, and Power of the Duelist can complete its two-, three- or four-Attribute choice.
42. Progression series exports now recreate a missing destination folder before saving the selected file.
43. Progression AI can rebuild its deck from newly earned cards before each duel, or use a deck you assign from its own series collection. Choose the mode under Opponent Deck.
44. Progression guests can choose their confirmed prizes and share the choice back to the organizer. Imports retain the saved player role and deck, while conflicting or repeated rewards are rejected. Sharing help now explains clipboard and file exports.
45. Saved Progression Series now provides a confirmed Delete action for individual series. Other saves remain available, and deleting the active series safely clears its selection.
46. Verified Cross Crusader and Infernal Devicer's native on-Link-Summon effects with legal summon sequences. Their card rules and scripts remain unchanged.
47. Confirming an Activation Order now leaves remaining eligible effects available for their next prompt. Effects without a supplied explanation no longer display an unknown-text speech bubble.
48. Card-selection windows remain usable around the Duel Log and Settings. Clicking outside the log closes it; opening Settings hides and suspends the pending selection until you return.
49. Restored the macOS Open, Save and Choose Folder plugin for Intel and Apple Silicon. Release Studio checks that the finished app contains a picker for each processor it supports.
50. Online ocgcore duels show the active player's remaining time in the existing round clock.
51. Returning to a scrolled public-deck search now focuses a visible result instead of an off-screen row, preventing an error while restoring the page.
52. Corrected the texture encoding used by Mac title and menu backgrounds and wallpapers that could appear as colored static on Intel GPUs.
53. Starting another game instance no longer rewrites an unchanged merged banlist. Updated lists are published atomically so existing readers keep a complete snapshot.
54. Ten Thousand Dragon now keeps its correct name, artwork and password instead of appearing as Gem-Knight Seraphinite. Host card passwords and native card IDs stay distinct in normal and foil rendering.
55. Evolution no longer reports a transport failure when the server abruptly closes its WebSocket after a complete DuelEnd message. Unfinished duels and incomplete packets still report failures, with improved connection diagnostics.
56. Old card-selection windows no longer submit choices to a later prompt. Retried online actions now restore the correct input context and allow a newer server choice to proceed.
57. Selecting an Extra Deck card after checking the Graveyard now keeps its card picture visible in the details panel.
58. Restored the Cancel and Confirm button artwork in the mobile Activation Order window, including the selected state.
59. Fixed Android rarity backups on storage that rejects hard links. Evolution reconnect timeouts now return to the game screen on Unity's main thread.
60. Corrected controller navigation when a button and a stick share a binding. Returning to a wallpaper list or closing a deck editor now handles selections and prompts that have already closed.
61. Reduced the startup wait for an online refresh from 15 seconds to 3 seconds when the game already has a verified card ID map.
62. Replays saved or resumed during chain selection now restore the activating card and chain order from the duel snapshot.
63. Fixed Text Search losing keyboard focus when Deck Builder results finish loading. You can also type a new search directly from Related Cards.
64. Added five Master Duel monster cut-ins, the Dark Magical Curtain activation animation and 32 cosmetics. The new Race menu background has an animated scene and a preview in the background picker.
65. Added three playable Card Effect showcases for Dark Magical Curtain, alternate-art AA-ZEUS and alternate-art Ultimate Slayer. Existing puzzle progress carries forward.
66. Windows, Linux and macOS now show an MDPro4 progress window while the desktop updater works after the game closes. It shows the current operation, file counts when available and where to find the log if the update fails.

platformNotes.linux:
1. Corrected Linux normal-map decoding for native Shine and Royal card finishes, preventing desktop texture channels from producing dark lighting.
2. Progression Join Room now opens a room-code field with Paste. Added clearer organizer and Player 2 instructions, including how to import the shared series before joining.
3. Leaving a Progression Evolution room now restores the Duel button immediately, without opening the Deck Editor first.
4. Evolution reconnect now retains the submitted match deck for side-decking, preventing the missing-deck error after reconnecting.
5. Progression card results now show the highest printed rarities first. A sorting button switches back to the original opening or pack order while preserving saved pulls and New markers. Restyled the owned-count toggle with a clear On/Off label.
6. Reduced the delay when entering Adventures by deferring unused Progression and Expedition catalogs while retaining saved-run recovery.
7. Pack openings now adapt when resizing the window. Card rows stay inside narrower screens with aligned reflections, while the opening pack keeps its authored size and proportions. Improved cleanup when cancelling or closing the game during an opening.
8. Improved tablet and foldable layouts: menus fit the available width, Settings lists use the available height, and near-square screens show a closer field view with hands beside the back rows. Cards stay visible and playback controls move clear of the hand. Safe-area spacing now follows the actual canvas scale.
9. Linux and macOS now remove consumed archive parts after a successful segmented update. Failed updates retain their downloads for retry, and unrelated or changed files are preserved.
10. Fixed battle-hit feedback timing out during accelerated duels and replays while the impact sound was still playing.
11. Automatic pre-release card checks now include Rush. Standard and Rush notices appear one at a time, and View update opens the matching update setting.
12. Test Hand can now create editable Combo Sheets from the opening hand, observed actions and the last complete board. Use Save Combo Sheet in duel settings, or From last Test Hand in My combo sheets after leaving the duel. Recording limits are explained in the saved draft.
13. Combo Sheet groups now keep cards together in compact rows. Reuse combo cards lets you add selected engine cards, counters, starting cards or endboard cards without clearing the current visual flow or its annotations.
14. Redesigned the Progression Series dashboard with a five-step guide, current-pack artwork, collection and score summaries, and a clear next action. Setup now labels series and opponent names, offers duel-count shortcuts and groups pack options; saved series have a readable rules summary and open the set track at the current set.
15. Removed full-list rebuilding when selecting or deselecting packs in Customize Set Track. Selection updates keep the current scroll position and focus, while search and Reset reuse the existing rows.
16. Progression region, duel count, LP, pack and opponent-type options now update in place without blinking or reopening the window. Returning from Customize Set Track refreshes the starting pack and Create Series availability while preserving entered names.
17. Fixed invisible cards intercepting OK and Sort clicks in scrolled Progression pack results. Card input now follows the visible viewport above the footer.
18. Restyled Progression windows with cyan-and-gold edge lighting, a shaded header and footer, and more compact Duel and Close buttons. The Duel Rules banlist action no longer overlaps Close.
19. Closing Review Opened Cards or Pack Contents now returns directly to the existing Progression menu without a blank frame or replaying its page fade. New pack openings and prizes still refresh the dashboard.
20. Face-down Extra Deck monsters now keep their designated Extra Deck Card Protector after moving to the field and when replaying a duel.
21. Card Finishes and customized frames now follow Display Face-Down Cards as Transparent, including after artwork loads. Fixed material errors when combining some finishes and frames.
22. Redesigned character profiles with localized colored name badges, consistently sized portraits and a compact biography over the shaded lower artwork. Details opens the full description. Added Riding Suit Yusei and Akiza, refreshed official character text and voice packs, and corrected Portuguese profile localization.
23. Deck Sync now restores missing synced files into the account's local sync group, even after restarting or deleting the folder. Recovery keeps the same cloud deck identities, preserves pending edits and respects cloud deletions. Ordinary original groups remain independent; save edits in the sync group, then use Sync now.
24. The deck list now adjusts its columns immediately when resizing the window, using the available ultrawide space without opening a deck and returning. Search results, checked decks and selection are retained.
25. Fixed tokens disappearing one by one when used as Link Summon materials. Token and monster material animations now overlap correctly, including during replay playback.
26. Raised the Deck Sync service limit to 600 deck identities per account. Synced decks now show readable names in the deck list, search, selection buttons and editor, while keeping their existing files and cloud identities. Renaming, copying and undo retain the correct deck association.
27. Fixed Fusion materials appearing twice during their departure animation, including materials banished by Albion the Branded Dragon. Material animations now keep one visible card and wait for artwork loading before the summon continues, including in replays.
28. Fixed startup with Master Duel 2.9.0 card data and reduced temporary allocations when reading encrypted card resources. Invalid optional native text metadata now preserves the normal card catalog and reports a warning.
29. Added release-player error reporting, sampled startup timings and crash-free session tracking to help diagnose failures and slow loading. Reports include version and platform information with filtered personal identifiers; session statistics use a separate pseudonymous installation identifier.
30. Native duels now recognize the reviewed Master Duel 2.9.0 engine revision. Native replays record their actual engine revision and continue to reject mismatched engines or card data.
31. Sorting a deck no longer gives priority to the card name left in the search box. Search results retain their own exact-name ordering.
32. Fixed an early surrender leaving the other player waiting on an obsolete action prompt. Starting another duel now waits for the previous field and interface to finish closing, preventing a late cleanup from hiding the new duel UI.
33. Pre-release card downloads now retry individual stalled chunks and tolerate slow transfers that continue making progress. Cancelling stops active downloads, and changing the card language prevents an outdated pack from being installed.
34. Combo Sheets now reject links in their text, imports and community uploads. Previously published links are hidden by the updated community service; local drafts remain available for recovery.
35. Added Report a player to the Evolution account menu. Select a recent match, opponent and reason, then send a description for administrator review. This requires the updated Evolution reporting API; reports do not automatically penalize players.
36. Added bounded disconnect diagnostics to error reporting, including transport failures, protocol opcodes and read timing without player names, chat, decks or connection addresses.
37. Cross Duel Exodia's tap animation no longer displays its cinematic mist, blackout background or full-screen flash over the duel field. Its attack animation remains available, and mate previews retain the full effects.
38. A failed optional mate load no longer leaves the duel waiting for the field. Incomplete Cross Duel mate instances are cleaned up if their native animation setup fails.
39. Duel Links mates now fit their duel stands using their animated body size. Native stage offsets no longer leave mates tiny or floating far from the stand; mate previews keep their existing framing.
40. Restored native Cross Duel trail effects and their cleanup between animations. Fixed Power Tool Dragon's entry effect and removed unused source-game card-stat labels that generated font warnings in mate previews.
41. Corrected native lighting and normal-map decoding in affected Duel Links summon animations, including Blue-Eyes White Dragon and Yubel. Holographic mate variants now identify their original presentation in the catalog.
42. Fixed several Duel Links animations stopping at unused native renderer slots or at a valid zero-blur phase.
43. Fixed Cross Duel screen-distortion effects sampling black instead of the scene in mate previews, including Gaia's attack ring.
44. Added an option to play only installed Duel Links summon animations. Cards without one use the normal summon presentation; individual animations can still be previewed in the viewer.
45. Corrected the raised dots in the viewer's Playing and Auto playing labels across all supported languages.
46. Restored missing Cross Duel summon-icon layouts, transform animations, raid-effect controllers and video tracks, fixing missing-script warnings for affected mates including Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon.
47. Card-selection windows now show their current prompt immediately, fixing a brief Chinese placeholder title while card rows load.
48. Added 13 card-effect demonstrations, including both Ghost Mourner and Effect Veiler artworks, Spirit Charmers, the newer Dominus cards and missing spell variants. The game and Starter Pack catalogs now include 60 showcases, with localized instructions and existing progress preserved.
49. The Duel Log now lists materials beneath Fusion, Synchro, Xyz, Link and Ritual Summons. Large material groups continue on additional rows, including repeated copies of the same card, in ordinary duels and replays.
50. Added Activation Order to duel settings. Eligible simultaneous effects can be selected and ordered together; effect explanations distinguish multiple effects offered by the same card.
51. Added Ghost Mourner & Moonlit Chill's original and alternate-art effect animations, including target tracking and cleanup when leaving a duel.
52. Native Master Duel duels now automatically choose one card when the engine explicitly requests a random face-down selection. Ordinary ocgcore keeps its existing automatic Bingo Machine, Go!!! selection.
53. Starting another puzzle now resets the Duel Log to Turn 1 and follows the current turn player correctly.
54. Closing a native duel during its result presentation no longer reports normal cancellation as a duel failure.
55. Replaced the older color and monochrome Manga styles with the imported Manga Frames, selectable for any artwork with the existing finish controls. Previous Manga selections migrate automatically.
56. Fixed Exit Replay opening an ineffective surrender prompt during Master Duel replay playback. Native replays can now be exited while running or paused.
57. Fixed missing native camera, rim-light and billboard script warnings in affected Duel Links cut-ins, along with two animation endings that stopped at a valid zero-bloom transition.
58. Corrected late material changes that left an affected Duel Links monster's armor and claws appearing as flat white plates.
59. Added the Duel Links riding stadium field with its native animation and looping sound.
60. Adapted native camera blur, color gradients and final backdrops in affected Duel Links cut-ins for landscape screens, removing portrait overlay borders while preserving the original actors and effects.
61. Restored eight Duel Links cut-ins previously excluded for rendering or playback problems, including Shooting Majestic Star Dragon, Trishula and Crimson Dragon. Corrected native effect ordering, bright trail polygons, animation cleanup and the remaining Blue-Eyes/Dark Magician overlay borders.
62. Expanded and rebalanced Duel Expedition opponent pools with historical deck lists. Added missing locale entries for their names and descriptions while preserving existing saved runs and their chosen lineups.
63. Restored attack and card-placement arrows in native Master Duel duels, including mouse and controller target focus, and the yellow Extra Deck highlight when a summon is available. Xyz Summons can now use zones occupied by their selected materials.
64. Native Special Summons in face-up Defense Position now show the defense shield instead of the Set icon. Retired selections no longer interfere with the next placement prompt.
65. Restored native card counters, including Bushido Counters, with localized names, icons and counter sounds. Counter changes and battle guidance also follow native replay playback.
66. Added Endless Tower as a separate Expedition mode: climb saved random floors with three lives, earn duel points, and choose upgrade packs, a life potion or saving points between victories. Opponent tiers rise to Expert. Existing Sanctuary runs keep their rules and progress.
67. Expedition Deck now uses the normal deck editor with a separate earned-card pool, owned-copy limits and guarded saves. Added a Tower floor dashboard, shop score breakdown and scoring help. Entrance, floor and result controls now sit outside the gate artwork. The Adventure background now extends behind the top header. Native-engine wins currently award the base victory score; supported ocgcore results also award performance bonuses.
platformNotes.macos:
1. Corrected Linux normal-map decoding for native Shine and Royal card finishes, preventing desktop texture channels from producing dark lighting.
2. Progression Join Room now opens a room-code field with Paste. Added clearer organizer and Player 2 instructions, including how to import the shared series before joining.
3. Leaving a Progression Evolution room now restores the Duel button immediately, without opening the Deck Editor first.
4. Evolution reconnect now retains the submitted match deck for side-decking, preventing the missing-deck error after reconnecting.
5. Progression card results now show the highest printed rarities first. A sorting button switches back to the original opening or pack order while preserving saved pulls and New markers. Restyled the owned-count toggle with a clear On/Off label.
6. Reduced the delay when entering Adventures by deferring unused Progression and Expedition catalogs while retaining saved-run recovery.
7. Pack openings now adapt when resizing the window. Card rows stay inside narrower screens with aligned reflections, while the opening pack keeps its authored size and proportions. Improved cleanup when cancelling or closing the game during an opening.
8. Improved tablet and foldable layouts: menus fit the available width, Settings lists use the available height, and near-square screens show a closer field view with hands beside the back rows. Cards stay visible and playback controls move clear of the hand. Safe-area spacing now follows the actual canvas scale.
9. Linux and macOS now remove consumed archive parts after a successful segmented update. Failed updates retain their downloads for retry, and unrelated or changed files are preserved.
10. Fixed battle-hit feedback timing out during accelerated duels and replays while the impact sound was still playing.
11. Automatic pre-release card checks now include Rush. Standard and Rush notices appear one at a time, and View update opens the matching update setting.
12. Test Hand can now create editable Combo Sheets from the opening hand, observed actions and the last complete board. Use Save Combo Sheet in duel settings, or From last Test Hand in My combo sheets after leaving the duel. Recording limits are explained in the saved draft.
13. Combo Sheet groups now keep cards together in compact rows. Reuse combo cards lets you add selected engine cards, counters, starting cards or endboard cards without clearing the current visual flow or its annotations.
14. Redesigned the Progression Series dashboard with a five-step guide, current-pack artwork, collection and score summaries, and a clear next action. Setup now labels series and opponent names, offers duel-count shortcuts and groups pack options; saved series have a readable rules summary and open the set track at the current set.
15. Removed full-list rebuilding when selecting or deselecting packs in Customize Set Track. Selection updates keep the current scroll position and focus, while search and Reset reuse the existing rows.
16. Progression region, duel count, LP, pack and opponent-type options now update in place without blinking or reopening the window. Returning from Customize Set Track refreshes the starting pack and Create Series availability while preserving entered names.
17. Fixed invisible cards intercepting OK and Sort clicks in scrolled Progression pack results. Card input now follows the visible viewport above the footer.
18. Restyled Progression windows with cyan-and-gold edge lighting, a shaded header and footer, and more compact Duel and Close buttons. The Duel Rules banlist action no longer overlaps Close.
19. Closing Review Opened Cards or Pack Contents now returns directly to the existing Progression menu without a blank frame or replaying its page fade. New pack openings and prizes still refresh the dashboard.
20. Face-down Extra Deck monsters now keep their designated Extra Deck Card Protector after moving to the field and when replaying a duel.
21. Card Finishes and customized frames now follow Display Face-Down Cards as Transparent, including after artwork loads. Fixed material errors when combining some finishes and frames.
22. Redesigned character profiles with localized colored name badges, consistently sized portraits and a compact biography over the shaded lower artwork. Details opens the full description. Added Riding Suit Yusei and Akiza, refreshed official character text and voice packs, and corrected Portuguese profile localization.
23. Deck Sync now restores missing synced files into the account's local sync group, even after restarting or deleting the folder. Recovery keeps the same cloud deck identities, preserves pending edits and respects cloud deletions. Ordinary original groups remain independent; save edits in the sync group, then use Sync now.
24. The deck list now adjusts its columns immediately when resizing the window, using the available ultrawide space without opening a deck and returning. Search results, checked decks and selection are retained.
25. Fixed tokens disappearing one by one when used as Link Summon materials. Token and monster material animations now overlap correctly, including during replay playback.
26. Raised the Deck Sync service limit to 600 deck identities per account. Synced decks now show readable names in the deck list, search, selection buttons and editor, while keeping their existing files and cloud identities. Renaming, copying and undo retain the correct deck association.
27. Fixed Fusion materials appearing twice during their departure animation, including materials banished by Albion the Branded Dragon. Material animations now keep one visible card and wait for artwork loading before the summon continues, including in replays.
28. Fixed startup with Master Duel 2.9.0 card data and reduced temporary allocations when reading encrypted card resources. Invalid optional native text metadata now preserves the normal card catalog and reports a warning.
29. Added release-player error reporting, sampled startup timings and crash-free session tracking to help diagnose failures and slow loading. Reports include version and platform information with filtered personal identifiers; session statistics use a separate pseudonymous installation identifier.
30. Native duels now recognize the reviewed Master Duel 2.9.0 engine revision. Native replays record their actual engine revision and continue to reject mismatched engines or card data.
31. Sorting a deck no longer gives priority to the card name left in the search box. Search results retain their own exact-name ordering.
32. Fixed an early surrender leaving the other player waiting on an obsolete action prompt. Starting another duel now waits for the previous field and interface to finish closing, preventing a late cleanup from hiding the new duel UI.
33. Pre-release card downloads now retry individual stalled chunks and tolerate slow transfers that continue making progress. Cancelling stops active downloads, and changing the card language prevents an outdated pack from being installed.
34. Combo Sheets now reject links in their text, imports and community uploads. Previously published links are hidden by the updated community service; local drafts remain available for recovery.
